description: CrimeFIR classification taxonomy. Crime types follow the NCRB Crime Details Form (I.I.F.-II) idea of Major Head / Minor Head; MO flags correspond to its 'Method(s)' field. Single source of truth for the pipeline, the dataset generator and the evaluation.

cyber.label: Cyber Crime
cyber.hint: offence committed using phones, internet, apps, online payments or social media

property.label: Crimes against Property
property.hint: physical theft, burglary, snatching or robbery of property

body.label: Crimes against the Body
body.hint: physical assault, hurt, threats or intimidation of a person

economic.label: Economic Offences (offline)
economic.hint: cheating or fraud done in person or on paper, without an online channel

cyber.kyc_bank_impersonation.label: OTP/KYC & bank-impersonation fraud
cyber.kyc_bank_impersonation.hint: caller poses as bank, card or KYC staff and takes OTP, card details or remote access to empty the account

cyber.fake_customer_care.label: Fake customer-care / helpline fraud
cyber.fake_customer_care.hint: victim calls a fake helpline number found online for a refund, courier or service complaint and is cheated

cyber.digital_arrest.label: Digital arrest / official impersonation
cyber.digital_arrest.hint: fraudsters pose as police, CBI, customs or courier officials, threaten arrest over a parcel or case and demand money

cyber.investment_trading.label: Investment / trading-app fraud
cyber.investment_trading.hint: victim is lured to invest in fake stock, crypto or trading apps promising high returns

cyber.job_task.label: Online job / task fraud
cyber.job_task.hint: part-time job or paid online tasks such as reviews or likes, then deposits demanded to unlock earnings

cyber.loan_app.label: Loan-app harassment & extortion
cyber.loan_app.hint: instant loan app agents harass, abuse or threaten with morphed photos to extort repayment

cyber.sextortion.label: Sextortion / online blackmail
cyber.sextortion.hint: obscene video call is recorded and victim is blackmailed, often by callers posing as police

cyber.marketplace.label: Online marketplace fraud
cyber.marketplace.hint: fake seller or buyer on an online marketplace, often posing as an army officer, takes advance payments

cyber.matrimonial.label: Matrimonial / romance fraud
cyber.matrimonial.hint: fake profile on a matrimonial or dating site builds a relationship and takes money

property.vehicle_theft.label: Vehicle theft
property.vehicle_theft.hint: two-wheeler, car or other vehicle stolen from where it was parked

property.burglary.label: House burglary
property.burglary.hint: house, flat or shop broken into, usually when locked or empty, and valuables stolen

property.snatching.label: Chain / mobile snatching
property.snatching.hint: chain, purse or mobile snatched from a person on the road, often by men on a motorcycle

property.robbery.label: Robbery
property.robbery.hint: property taken from a person by force or by threatening with a weapon

property.theft_other.label: Other theft
property.theft_other.hint: theft of property without force, such as pickpocketing, theft from shop, office or bus

body.assault.label: Assault / hurt
body.assault.hint: a person is beaten, attacked or injured

body.intimidation.label: Criminal intimidation
body.intimidation.hint: a person is threatened with harm, without an online fraud, often over a dispute

economic.cheating_offline.label: Cheating (offline)
economic.cheating_offline.hint: cheated in person, for example a fake job agent, land or plot deal, or chit fund, without an online channel

mo_flags.impersonated_bank_official: the offender pretended to be from a bank, card department or KYC team
mo_flags.impersonated_customer_care: the offender pretended to be customer care or a helpline of a company
mo_flags.impersonated_police_or_agency: the offender pretended to be police, CBI, customs, courier or another government officer
mo_flags.impersonated_army_officer: the offender pretended to be an army or defence officer
mo_flags.asked_otp_or_card_details: the victim was asked to share an OTP, PIN, CVV or card details
mo_flags.remote_access_app: the victim was made to install a screen-sharing or remote-access app such as AnyDesk or QuickSupport
mo_flags.phishing_link_or_fake_app: the victim was sent a link, APK or fake app or website
mo_flags.video_call_used: a video call was part of the crime
mo_flags.threat_of_arrest_or_case: the victim was threatened with arrest, a police case or legal action
mo_flags.morphed_or_obscene_content: morphed, obscene or intimate photos or videos were used to threaten
mo_flags.promise_of_high_returns: the victim was promised high profits or returns on money
mo_flags.paid_tasks_or_job_offer: the victim was offered a job or paid online tasks
mo_flags.advance_or_fee_payment: the victim paid an advance, fee, charge or deposit before receiving something
mo_flags.fake_marketplace_listing: a fake item was listed for sale online
mo_flags.fake_relationship_or_marriage: the offender built a romantic or marriage relationship to gain trust
mo_flags.loan_app_recovery_harassment: loan app agents harassed the victim or the victim's contacts
mo_flags.money_to_mule_account: money was transferred to a bank account or UPI ID controlled by the offenders
mo_flags.motorcycle_used: the offenders used a motorcycle or scooter to commit or flee
mo_flags.weapon_shown: a knife, gun or other weapon was used or shown
mo_flags.forced_entry: a lock, door, window or grill was broken to enter
mo_flags.premises_unoccupied: the house or shop was locked or empty at the time
mo_flags.vehicle_taken_from_parking: a vehicle was stolen from where it was parked
mo_flags.physical_violence: the victim was beaten or physically hurt
mo_flags.verbal_threat_in_person: the victim was threatened face to face or over a personal dispute
